name: stake
description: Stake BlocTime (BLOC) on the apps registered in the on-chain Registry. Each registered app is a staking pool: back an app with BLOC as a curation signal, unstake any time (never locked), and app owners can add BLOC rewards that split pro-rata across their stakers. AppStaking.sol on Base Sepolia against the live BlocTime + Registry, one-page console + JSON API.
